laws.normalized: round-half-up(raw * target_max / 127), clamp to target descriptor; heuristic, not equivalent Hz/ms/gain
laws.wave: If saw >= pulse and saw > 0: SUB when sub > 0 else SAW. Otherwise PWM when pulse > 0. Otherwise SUB when sub > 0 (mix127); otherwise SAW with NOIS (silent oscillator cannot be isolated).
laws.sub_mix: round-half-up(127*sub/(saw+sub)); amplitude ratio heuristic, not source independent mixer gains
laws.selectors: All raw selector bins unverified: do not decode. Fixed mono retrigger, triangle LFO, LP filter, no glide, no transpose, no chord synthesis, centered PWM; explicit losses.
laws.filter_env: nonnegative 0..127 source depth -> 0..63 target depth, shared amplitude ADSR; response law unknown
laws.lfo: normalized rate and nonnegative pitch/filter depth -> 0..127 and 0..63; default target triangle is an assumption
laws.missing: default raw0 with a per-field missing/defaulted loss; strict rejects missing patch candidates
laws.overrides: only explicit bounded output values with nonempty rationale; never decode a selector implicitly

limitations: ANALOG trapezoidal SVF is not the SH filter; normalized cutoff/resonance/key-follow and envelope time laws are not calibrated.
A single shared amplitude ADSR also drives filter modulation; source envelope mode and gate behavior are not reproduced.
Unknown range selector: no octave/transposition inference. Existing track scale/transposition is retained.

Unknown PWM source/width response: centered pulse, no PWM routing; SUB shape/type fixed at target octave-down square.
LFO waveform/mode unknown: target triangle default; rate/depth normalized only; no SH timing/sync claim.
Glide/portamento mode and bend/mod sensitivity omitted; target glide disabled, normal host performance controls remain.
Source noise color unverified; existing target noise only. Source oscillator absolute gains not preserved.
